fixes: Bridge shows an account panel instead of disabled email and password fields when signed in, including after manual Disconnect.
Sign out restores editable credentials. Keyboard-event input and account layout have automated GUI coverage.
Reset links are bound to the current password state and consumed by an atomic conditional database update; reused or stale links cannot change the password.
Purpose-specific reset tokens cannot authenticate as web or Bridge sessions.
Invalid, expired, missing-expiry and malformed reset claims fail without changing the password.
Forgot-password and reset pages show readable validation errors; reset errors provide a direct request-new-link action.
reset_compatibility: Reset links issued before this release must be replaced by requesting a fresh link. Existing passwords and ordinary sign-in tokens are unchanged. This change does not introduce revocation of all existing web sessions on password reset.
